acceptance_criteria: Initial query failure and a complete all-instance failure render unavailable rather than numeric zero or no-data copy.
Partial observations retain the measured subtotal only with explicit observed, expected, and failed coverage.
A completely observed real zero remains distinct from unavailable and not-applicable.
Retained data after refetch failure remains explicitly stale until a fresh successful observation proves recovery.
Ops charts, Ops KPI cards, and Fleet KPI cards consume one typed availability, coverage, and freshness projection.
The Fleet KPI strip never uses the independent lines response as evidence that the metrics response is complete.
Behavior and mutation tests cover query failure, all failed, partial, complete empty, complete nonempty, not-applicable, stale retained, and recovered states.
Public UI and test projections contain only bounded aggregate states and reserved synthetic values.
blast_radius: Fleet-wide message and token KPI truth, partial-coverage interpretation, query-failure and recovery presentation, incident and capacity decisions, and any later alert or self-heal policy that consumes the same console projection.
evidence_summary: Exact-main-identical source reduces absent metrics arrays to zero in Ops, gives its KPI cards only the reduced values, discards Fleet metrics query state in SoupKitchen, and maps one nullable token total to either an unqualified fleet sum or no-token-data copy. The producer already returns queried and failed instance counts, and the chart consumer already uses them, so adjacent chart and KPI projections can disagree. Eighteen write-free source assertions reproduced those seams. All twelve cited decisive source and test paths are byte-identical to pinned main. The five cited focused suites passed 88 of 88 tests under the repository-pinned runtime, but none asserts KPI behavior for query failure, all-failed, or partial coverage. Three live identity reads spanning 26 seconds were stable with six current labels; the node, open state, title, URL, update time, and exact body hash remained unchanged while local and SSH remote main stayed at the pin. At the reviewed cutoff, two complete captures stabilized at the same byte hash over 235 open issues, all 39 open pull requests, all changed-file pages, all closing-reference pages, and 37 labels. No open pull request references, closes, semantically owns, or implements this issue; three broad drafts collide only by path. The same-cutoff all-state search covered 528 issues and 1,984 pull requests. Later publication-time full-capture attempts detected top-level inventory drift and failed closed, so estate freshness requires the declared final rescan.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The issue is falsified if the pinned consumers can preserve unavailable, partial, complete, not-applicable, stale, and recovered states at every KPI value without inferring them from nullable numbers. Exact source assertions show they cannot. The issue body reports four removed audit-only rendering tests, so those exact failing renders cannot be independently rerun from the current tree; the green focused suites prove current regression behavior, not the missing observation contract.
impact: A failed observation can appear as a measured zero, and a partial subtotal can appear fleet-complete, causing operators or future automation to misclassify outages, capacity, and recovery.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2528 immediately before publication and reject the record if its state, node identity, title, labels, update time, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm SSH origin, tracking main, remote main, and API main agreement before integrating the record.
Coordinate canonical availability and freshness vocabulary with #2447 and presentation behavior with #2523 while keeping #2514 and #2522 as distinct producer domains.
Add executable truth-table and mutation tests for unavailable, partial, complete-zero, not-applicable, stale-retained, and recovered KPI projections before claiming completion.
Re-scan every open pull request and all changed-file and closing-reference pages immediately before assigning ownership; PRs #2078, #2500, and #2501 are collision-only drafts.
Keep #2528 and #2529 in one review wave but preserve separate owner boundaries for fleet aggregate metrics and per-line metric availability.
